form.official-title: To require Amtrak to publicly disclose certain bonus compensation paid to Amtrak executives, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Amtrak Executive Bonus Disclosure Act.
Section 24315(a) of title 49, United States Code, is amended—

paragraph.text: by inserting , and make available to the public on the website of Amtrak, after submit to Congress; and
by striking paragraph (2) and inserting the following:

provide the annual base pay and any bonus compensation paid to a member of the executive leadership team (including the chief executive officer, president, and officers) of Amtrak, including the criteria and metrics used to determine any such bonus compensation; and

bill.official-title-amendment: Amend the title so as to read: A bill to amend title 49, United States Code, to require Amtrak to include information on base pay and bonus compensation of certain Amtrak executives, and for other purposes..
